about.title: About
about.bio: At nine years old, Artem Kukharuk is developing the foundations of a composed and positionally intelligent defender — reading the game early, holding his shape under pressure, and competing with intensity that belies his age. Training within the Viva Cup youth programme, he is building technical discipline alongside match-day habits that experienced coaches recognise as the hallmarks of a serious defensive prospect. As he continues to grow physically and tactically, Artem's combination of awareness, work rate, and competitive drive positions him as a player to watch in his age group.

club.title: Club
club.name: Viva Cup
club.description: Viva Cup is a youth football club based in Khmelnytskyi, Ukraine, developing players from age 4 through the junior ranks. A technical partner of JOMA and SELECT, the club competes in the Khmelnytskyi Region Youth Football League (DYUFL) across multiple age groups — giving young players like Artem a structured, competitive environment to grow their game.
